notes.title: Now Available: Steam Trading Cards
notes.content:
Hello squadmates,

After taking in some feedback from the community, we've decided to create and add trading cards for Aegis!

We hope you like them, and please contact us if you have any comments or questions.

Enjoy,

-Innuendo Squad Studios
